equations.extrema: F3 increases with Fs, decreases with Qts; alpha minimum at 1/(2*Qts^2), maxima at endpoints

F3 relative to mathematical asymptotic high-pass gain
Ideal linear sealed compliance, supplied effective volume

numerical_policy.scope: Output representation only, not physical uncertainty
